name: Eucalyptus extract
description: Eucalyptus extract (CAS 92502-70-0 ) is a botanical-derived ingredient obtained from the leaves of Eucalyptus species, standardized for active compounds such as cineole. It functions as a flavoring agent and fragrance component across personal care, pharmaceutical, and food applications. In oral care formulations, such as toothpastes, mouthwashes, and breath fresheners, the extract delivers the sharp, cooling flavor profile that consumers associate with cleanliness and efficacy. Food and beverage manufacturers incorporate it as a natural flavoring in confectionery and lozenges. The ingredient is also utilized in functional drinks where a menthol-adjacent taste is required. Pharmaceutical formulators use it in cough drops, throat sprays, and topical preparations where the extract contributes to the product's sensory character and performance. In personal care and cosmetic products such as shampoos, shower gels, and skin creams, it provides fragrance differentiation. This ingredient supports a natural or botanical positioning for brands looking to appeal to health-conscious consumer demographics. Eucalyptus extract is supplied as a liquid extract, dry powder, or concentrated oil-based form depending on the intended application. Standard grades include food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications for various industrial manufacturing needs. Some suppliers offer material compliant with FCC or BP references to ensure high quality. Buyers should confirm standardization levels, particularly cineole content, when evaluating batches for consistent performance across formulations.
